description: Estadísticas de Incendios Forestales, MMARN, 2025 is a dataset listed in Dominican Republic national open data portal (datos.gob.do), an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministerio de Medio Ambiente y Recursos Naturales (MMARN). Este conjunto de datos contiene las estadísticas de incendios forestales del Ministerio del Medio Ambiente y Recursos Naturales (MMARN), generadas en el periodo 2016-2025, en el que se puede encontrar provincia y municipio donde se produjeron los incendios, también causas que los produjeron, tareas afectadas y fecha de extinción. Coverage: República Dominicana. The portal files it under the publisher Ministerio de Medio Ambiente y Recursos Naturales (MMARN). Its tags are Medio Ambiente, Recursos Naturales. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, ODS, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-02-19 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-do-portal.
